name: show_play
description: Show one saved play on the coach's screen. Pass the id of a play returned by search_plays, and hash 'left' or 'right' when the coach named one. Returns 'shown' when the drawing is on screen, 'shown, but no <hash> hash version is saved' when that hash was never saved, 'not found', 'superseded: a newer request is on screen' when a later show replaced this one (nothing went wrong), or a string starting 'error:' when the playbook could not be reached.

play_id.description: The id of the play to show, exactly as returned by search_plays.

hash.description: The hash the coach asked for ('left' or 'right'). Omit it when the coach did not say a hash.
